title: DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.13651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. translated_title: DrugCoding：一个用于药物发现的科学编程智能体
translated_abstract: 药物发现涉及多个相互关联的研究阶段，包括分子设计、性质预测和虚拟筛选。这些过程具有复杂的工作流程、相互依赖的计算任务以及多样化的专业工具，对科学模型和计算资源的协调提出了很高的要求。然而，现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体在复杂任务的自主规划、专业模型的自适应选择以及多阶段科学计算的可靠执行方面仍面临挑战，限制了其在自动化复杂药物发现工作流程中的有效性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DrugCoding，一个集成了科学任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作和程序化工具执行的科学编程智能体系统。DrugCoding能够实现自主任务规划和动态模型选择……
tldr: 提出了DrugCoding，一个融合科学任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化工具执行的科学编程智能体系统，能够自动化复杂的药物发现工作流程。
en_tdlr: DrugCoding is proposed as a scientific programming agent that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution to automate complex drug discovery workflows.
